card.name: Digits inside day and week numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the first or later digit of a multi-digit number, mostly after Day, Week or month in a dosing or study schedule. It also fires inside other numbers such as 20/200.

modes.label: Day or week numbers
modes.description: Digit in a numbered day, week or month of a schedule or trial timepoint.

modes.label: Other number parts
modes.description: Digit partway through a ratio or code, such as visual acuity.
modes.example: change in BCVA to 20/2<<0>>0 or worse

card.writes: It promotes digit tokens, so the next piece is likely another digit to finish the number.
card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a number, usually a day or week in a treatment schedule.
